questions.q: A manager has 12 workers reporting directly to her. This number is her:
questions.why: Span of control = the number of subordinates working directly under a manager.

questions.q: Which document lists the qualifications, experience and qualities of the ideal applicant?
questions.why: A job description is about the job; a person specification is about the person.

questions.q: A factory closes a production line and its workers lose their jobs. This is:
questions.why: Redundancy: the job is no longer needed, not because the worker's performance was unsatisfactory.

questions.q: Outline one benefit of a democratic leadership style.
questions.model: Employees are involved in decisions, so they feel valued and become more motivated (and may contribute useful ideas).
points: feel valued / more motivated / better ideas
